reverie.title: REVERIE — the rooftop where you learned silence carries sign
narr: You sat up here with her, the city below
so loud it erased itself. She pointed to the dark.
'Listen,' she said, 'not to the noise. To what
the noise is trying not to say.' The wind came,
carrying information only the quiet could hold.
You understood: silence is not empty.

exits.label: back toward the wind learning to read
higher still, where the aperture opens to stars
into the void-sound beyond the wind
back toward the measured world of days
